Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Atlas demo recording + slides — next steps

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for carving out time today to walk through the Atlas use case. I enjoyed learning more about how your team handles long-form document search and the latency/cost constraints you mentioned. Per our conversation, I’ve attached the recording and the slide deck so your team can share with stakeholders.

Attachments:
- Atlas-demo-recording.mp4 (video, ~42MB) — 33-minute recording of the demo
- Atlas-demo-slides.pdf (8 slides) — TL;DR slides + architecture notes

Quick recap / proposed next steps:
- Your team to review the recording + slides with engineering and infra (ETA: 1 week)
- 15-min Q&A with me to answer any technical questions and run through batching/quant profiles
- If we’re aligned, I’ll put together a mutual action plan and an initial sizing estimate for Dedicated capacity

If helpful, here are a couple slots I have next week for a short Q&A (all PT):
- Tue 3/3 10:30–10:45
- Wed 3/4 09:00–09:15
- Thu 3/5 14:00–14:15
Or feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://cal.redwoodinference.com/marissa/15

Drive link to assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-demo-assets
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/contacts/DEAL-4839

If the timing has shifted or this isn’t a priority right now, no worries — let me know and I can follow up later.

Best,
